question: Why is the same consciousness also called Saṃkarṣiṇī among the Mothers?
premises: She draws time back into herself.
Among these Mothers this is her true mode of being, so she is called Saṃkarṣiṇī.
inference: Her dual act of drawing in and projecting out time establishes her identity as Saṃkarṣiṇī among the Mothers.
plain_english: She again draws time back from herself and also projects it outward; therefore she is declared Saṃkarṣiṇī, and this is her true being among these Mothers.
